independent_solutions.solver_a:
1. No external torque acts on the disc-insect system about the vertical axis.
2. Angular momentum L is conserved. L = I * omega = constant.
3. As the insect moves from rim to center, the moment of inertia I decreases, so omega increases.
independent_solutions.solver_b:
Angular momentum L = I omega is conserved since there is no external torque.
When the insect moves from rim to centre, the moment of inertia I decreases.
Since L is constant, the angular speed omega increases.
